chapter: Cage in Louisiana, minstrels and learning fiddle
title: Building his house at Zachary
summary: Cage says he came back in 1927 and has lived in the house he built since about 1944.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I come here back in 27 and been here ever since. And you've been in this same house for how long? I built this house. About... About 44 I moved in here. Before I ever came to Louisiana? Yes, sir. Yes, sir. That was...
I didn't come here until like... Well, I moved in here.
Well I moved in there. I've been here 20 some years.
